summary: Elevated interior views of the Carrier Dome / JMA Wireless Dome, football layout. No qualifying post-2022 (new roof, centre-hung board) elevated photo exists on Commons as of 2026-11-25, so all three are pre-renovation (old fabric roof). In all three the field sits in the middle-lower part of the frame (roughly 48-86% of height), not the top 40%; use a top crop/offset (e.g. start the visible frame around 25-30% of height) so field and stands land in the visible band.
download_note: upload.wikimedia.org returned HTTP 429, so files were fetched via commons.wikimedia.org/w/thumb.php at the original pixel width. Pixel dimensions match the originals; the JPEG is re-encoded by Wikimedia's thumbnailer, so byte size is smaller than the original upload.

files.field_region: Field (marching band 'Block S' pregame formation) spans full width, y ~1250-2510 (48-97%); stands y ~210-1250 (8-48%); roof only a thin strip y 0-210 (0-8%). Most field-and-stands, least roof of the three. Crowd sparse (pregame).
